title: Fixed line rules in a header strip: exact 200 under Calibri 11 is a 10 pt line, exact 480 with two br-lines pitches 24, atLeast 400 pitches 20, atLeast 200 under an 11 pt run keeps the natural 13.42 line
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-10-29), pymupdf: Letter 1440 margins, header 720, docDefaults Calibri 11; exact 200 baseline 44.16 (strip 10, body stays at 72.05); exact 480 baselines 55.20 / 79.20 (pitch 24.00, body 84.05 = 36 + 48); atLeast 400 baselines 53.04 / 72.96 (pitch 19.92, body 76.13 = 36 + 40); atLeast 200 baseline 46.56 like the 11 pt control. gen's strip paragraphs emitted the fixed line-height but not the run cap (--doc-lh-cap), the lead placement (--doc-lead-top) or the .doc-lh-fixed class the body uses, nor --doc-line-mult for multiples

cases.note: exact 200: the 11 pt glyphs are clipped to a 10 pt line, runs capped at the rule
atLeast 200 under 11 pt text: the natural line wins
